items.title: The Hidden Engine That Could Drive Walt Disney Stock Higher
items.summary: The debate over parks and box office hits is missing the real story: Disney's streaming business has finally turned into a profit machine.

items.title: Get Paid 12% A Year To Hold NFLX Stock You Already Own
items.summary: For Netflix shareholders, here is a way to get paid a meaningful income right now, money you keep no matter what, in exchange for agreeing to sell your stock at a higher price if it climbs.

items.title: What's at stake for Paramount, the Ellisons in Warner Bros. takeover bid
items.summary: Paramount Skydance (PSKY) is facing some pushback from a collection of US attorneys general in its proposed acquisition of rival Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD). Evan Shapiro — better known as "The Media Cartographer" — comes on Market Domination Overtime to outline what is it at stake for the media giant and the Ellison family if the deal ultimately falls through.

items.title: Netflix May Be Ready to Do Something It Long Resisted
items.summary: The streamer is discussing bringing rival services onto its platform.

items.title: 3 Consumer Stocks with Open Questions
items.summary: The performance of consumer discretionary businesses is closely linked to economic cycles. Unfortunately, the industry’s recent performance suggests demand may be slowing as discretionary stocks’ 6.2% return over the past six months has trailed the S&P 500 by 4.8 percentage points.

items.title: Netflix Has Changed What It Wants To Be Judged On
items.summary: The on-demand library it was built on is no longer the story management leads with, and the quality measure it now sets beside view hours is one the company will not detail.

items.title: Comcast adds new service to internet plans as customers leave
items.summary: Comcast is taking a new approach as it works to retain customers amid elevated competition.

items.title: Sky accused of massaging Bake Off maker accounts
items.summary: Sky has been accused of drawing up misleading accounts for its business that produces The Great British Bake Off and mounting a cover-up.
